title: NOSTRADAMUS Open Call #1: one topic, four sprints
body: A proposed T4 project building on Module M4 (pest and disease management). Programme facts are taken from the official documents listed below, checked on 7 November 2026. Where anything here differs from those documents, the documents win.

facts.label: Topic
facts.value: T4 · Smart and predictive pest and disease management
facts.detail: Exactly one topic. Choosing T4 commits the project to Module M4 and its datasets (Annex 1.1, Table 3).

facts.label: Primary site
facts.value: Cyprus or Germany. Not yet chosen
facts.detail: The other country becomes the paired site, replicated digitally on its Data Cube, EO and IoT data with no field work there (Annex 1.1 §8.1, §10.2). A Bihor partner farm is useful preparation. It does not replace the official site.

facts.label: Deadline
facts.detail: Submission deadline only. Contracting is indicated for April 2027 and is subject to change (Annex 1, Table 4).

facts.label: Funding
facts.value: Lump sum up to €50,000, paid per sprint
facts.detail: 10% / 25% / 40% / 25%, released only after formal approval of each sprint's results. Funding is not guaranteed.

facts.label: Maturity
facts.detail: Starting TRL4 is an eligibility criterion (Annex 1, criterion 14). Our TRL4 target date is 28 Nov 2026, and it is not yet declared.

timelineNote: Dates after the deadline come from Annex 1, Table 4 and may change.
assumedStartNote: Months assume programme month 1 = April 2027, the indicative contracting month. Programme months count from the contract, not from the November 2026 evidence sprint.

sprints.name: Training
official: At least 10 h of synchronous training completed
Verified access to services and one proof-of-connection
Approved use-case brief linked to the demo site
outputs: Confirmed interfaces for M4 outputs, Data Cube and IoT Observatory
Agreed validation protocol: sample unit, independent reviewer, metrics
Stakeholder needs recorded with the site partner
dependencies: Primary site chosen: Cyprus or Germany

sprints.name: Design
official: Co-design with the site's Multi-Actor Platform (MAP) stakeholders
Technical design signed off by mentors
Deployment strategy: cloud, edge or mixed
outputs: User workflow: stations, visits, specimens, review states
Data and architecture contracts: observation schema, export, M4 ingestion
Independent evaluation plan with group-aware splits
acceptance: Design report (DEL 2.1) with stakeholder inputs traced to requirements
dependencies: Data Dictionary entries for any external data

sprints.name: Development & Validation
official: Verified ingestion from Data Cubes, IoT Observatory, EO and core modules
Validation report: performance, reliability, usability, scalability
outputs: Integration and testing at the primary site
Digital transferability run on the paired site
acceptance: Failure log: acquisition, GPS, inference, sync
Independently assessed performance on held-out groups
Measured edge vs cloud vs mixed latency, energy and connectivity
dependencies: Crop stages available inside the sprint window
Site connectivity and IoT stream availability

sprints.name: Demonstration & Assessment
official: On-site demo with at least 10 participants at the primary site
At least one training session led by the third party
Final assessment, an EIP-AGRI practice abstract and a public open-source repository
outputs: Operational demonstration of the bounded workflow (TRL7)
Impact assessment against the month-2 baseline
dependencies: A KPI measurement design for pesticide use
Event logistics with the site partner

criteria.title: Evaluation criteria
criteria.note: Each criterion is scored 0–5 by two external evaluators. The threshold is 3 per criterion and 12 out of 20 overall. No score is promised.

items.name: Alignment
items.focus: Fit with T4 and M4, and a consistent path from TRL4 to TRL7

items.name: Excellence
items.focus: Measurable objectives, credible method, responsible AI and bias mitigation

items.name: Impact
items.focus: Benefit to users, adoption, transferability and barriers. Impact is the first tie-break

items.name: Implementation
items.focus: Realistic plan, budget, team and risk mitigation

calendar.title: Calendar check
calendar.note: These are typical regional cereal calendars, not site data. Confirm them with the site partners (ECoE/MARDE in Cyprus, DLG in Germany) before planning validation.

rows.cyprus: End of season: ripening to harvest

calendar.implication: Inside the S3 window, either site mostly offers early crop stages. Leaf-symptom validation may need the S4 window, historical site data or a pre-agreed protocol.

dependencies.title: Programme dependencies still unverified
items: Applicant entity: SME, start-up or small mid-cap with a valid VAT number. Natural persons and unincorporated start-ups are not eligible
TRL4 evidence pack ready before submission
Primary site choice (Cyprus or Germany) and site crop, varieties and calendar
Access and formats for M4 outputs, Data Cube APIs and IoT Observatory streams
How the >40% pesticide-reduction evidence would be measured, or which KPI applies
Detailed demo event and training requirements, to be checked against the final Annex 1.1 text
